item.title: 📍 Anti-drone dome: Dnepr Group's servicemen continue to protect logistics routes. Kherson region
item.description: Anti-drone dome: Dnepr Group's servicemen continue to protect logistics routes. 📍 Kherson region 🛠 The 18th Combined Arms Army's engineers finished another stage of anti-drone tunnel system construction. item.title: ▫️ Performing flawless job! Servicemen of the 41st Motorised Rifle Regiment (the 44th Army Corps, the Sever Group of Forces) told about the liberation of Barilovka (Sumy region).
item.description: ▫️ Performing flawless job! Servicemen of the 41st Motorised Rifle Regiment (the 44th Army Corps, the Sever Group of Forces) told about the liberation of Barilovka (Sumy region). ▫️ Before breaking through the enemy's defences, assaultmen, artillerymen, and UAVs worked as a single body and completely revealed the AFU's main defence nodes. 📍 Russian scouts found out exact coordinates of enemy strongholds, firing positions, and ‘nests’ with manpower. Then Russian artillery and FPV drones delivered concentrated strikes. 🔥 During the assault, the artillerymen frightened the enemy non-stop, burning down the militants' positions both in Barilovka and on the withdrawal routes behind the settlement, providing Russian servicemen with an advancement corridor. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: 🎖 by Russian Defence Ministry on progress of special military operation as of 2 November 2026
item.description: 🎖 🎖 by Russian Defence Ministry on progress of special military operation as of 2 November 2026 Part 2 ( 👉 see Part 1 ) ↗️ The Vostok Group's units advanced to the depth of the enemy's defence. They inflicted losses on manpower and hardware of one mechanised brigade, one assault regiment of the AFU, and one marine brigade close to Novorozovka, Tersyanka (Zaporozhye region), Pokrovskoye, Ivanovka, and Pavlovka (Dnepropetrovsk region). ▪️ The AFU lost up to 195 troops, three armoured fighting vehicles, three motor vehicles, and one field artillery gun. 📍 The Dnepr Group's units improved the situation along the front line. item.title: 📍 The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation.
item.description: The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation. 📍 Units of the Sever Group of Forces took more advantageous lines and positions. 💥 In Kharkov region, strikes were delivered at manpower and hardware of two mechanised brigades, one assault regiment of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, and one national guard brigade near Kolodeznoye, Shipovatoye, Vodyanoye, and Martovoye. 🔥 Besides, in Sumy region, strikes were delivered at formations of one mechanised brigade of the AFU and one territorial defence brigade close to Ivolzhanskoye and the city of Sumy. ▪️ The enemy lost up to 110 troops, three armoured fighting vehicles, five motor vehicles, and one electronic warfare station. 📍 The Zapad Group of Forces improved the situation along the front line. They inflicted losses on manpower and hardware of two mechanised brigades, one assault brigade of the Armed Forces of Ukraine and one marine brigade near Studenok, Glushchenkovo, Vishnevka (Kharkov region), and Rubtsy (Donetsk People's Republic). ▪️ The AFU losses amounted to up to 115 troops, three armoured fighting vehicles, eight motor vehicles, and one artillery gun. ↗️ Units of the Yuzhnaya Group of Forces improved the tactical situation. Russian units hit formations of three mechanised brigades, one mountain assault brigade of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, and one territorial defence brigade close to Kramatorsk, Slavyansk, Nikolayevka, and Vasilevskaya Pustosh (Donetsk People's Republic). ▪️ More than
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://t.me/mod_russia_en/30400

The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation.
📍
Units of the Sever Group of Forces took more advantageous lines and positions.
💥
In Kharkov region, strikes were delivered at
manpower and hardware of two mechanised brigades, one assault regiment of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, and one national guard brigade near Kolodeznoye, Shipovatoye, Vodyanoye, and Martovoye.
🔥
Besides, in Sumy region, strikes were delivered at
formations of one mechanised brigade of the AFU and one territorial defence brigade close to Ivolzhanskoye and the city of Sumy.
▪️
The enemy lost up to 110 troops, three armoured fighting vehicles, five motor vehicles, and one electronic warfare station.
📍
The Zapad Group of Forces improved the situation along the front line.
They inflicted losses on manpower and hardware of two mechanised brigades, one assault brigade of the Armed Forces of Ukraine and one marine brigade near Studenok, Glushchenkovo, Vishnevka (Kharkov region), and Rubtsy (Donetsk People's Republic).
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to up to 115 troops, three armoured fighting vehicles, eight motor vehicles, and one artillery gun.
↗️
Units of the Yuzhnaya Group of Forces improved the tactical situation.
Russian units hit formations of three mechanised brigades, one mountain assault brigade of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, and one territorial defence brigade close to Kramatorsk, Slavyansk, Nikolayevka, and Vasilevskaya Pustosh (Donetsk People's Republic).
▪️
More than 150 troops, two armoured fighting vehicles, and 25 motor vehicles of the AFU have been neutralised.
📍
The Tsentr Group of Forces took more advantageous lines and positions.
Manpower and hardware of three mechanised brigades, one assault regiment of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, one special forces brigade, and one national guard brigade have been hit near Stepanovka, Sergeyevka, Krinitsy, Kamyshevakha, Andreyevka, and Kamenka (Donetsk People's Republic).
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to up to 335 troops, 11 armoured fighting vehicles, seven motor vehicles, one artillery gun, and two electronic warfare stations.
👉
See
Part 2
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry
